title: SPA security baselines: CSP, sanitised dynamic HTML, hardened session cookies, no bundled secrets
description: The application ships a named Content-Security-Policy, never renders user-influenced data through raw HTML injection without a sanitiser, sets session cookies with Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes, round-trips form values XSS-safely, and includes no secrets or privileged endpoints in the shipped bundle.
rationale: These are the SPA-applicable floors. Anything below them is a vulnerability, not a style choice.
